source_refs.note: Exercise 11.3, Question 1: book page 295 (instruction for Q1-Q5). The book prints no answers for Unit 11.

blocks.prompt: 1 Find the velocity, acceleration, speed, and direction of motion of the particle with position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2\sin t\,\hat{i} + 3t\,\hat{j}\) at \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\). Interpret the results by describing the particle's motion at that instant, including how fast and in what direction it is moving, whether it is speeding up or slowing down, and how its path is curving.
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke sawal kis qisam ka hai: particle ki position ek vector function \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) ki shakal mein di hui hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2\sin t\,\hat{i} + 3t\,\hat{j}\) aur lamha \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Find kya karna hai? Velocity, acceleration, speed, direction, aur phir lafzon mein harkat ka bayan.
Rule kaunsa? Velocity pehla derivative, acceleration doosra derivative; speed velocity ki lambai.
Plan: differentiate, value rakho, lambai nikalo, divide karo, aur aakhir mein \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a}\) aur \(\mathbf{a}\) ki simt se tashreeh karo.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2\sin t\,\hat{i} + 3t\,\hat{j}\), \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\).
Maloom karna: velocity, acceleration, speed, direction of motion aur harkat ki tashreeh.
Tareeqa: har component ko ek dafa differentiate kar ke \(\mathbf{v}(t)\), dobara kar ke \(\mathbf{a}(t)\), phir \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) rakhna. Speed \(= |\mathbf{v}|\) aur direction \(= \frac{\mathbf{v}}{|\mathbf{v}|}\). Tashreeh (interpretation) ke liye: \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a}\) ka sign batata hai ke particle tez ho raha hai ya dheema, aur \(\mathbf{a}\) ka jo hissa \(\mathbf{v}\) ke aar paar hai woh batata hai ke path kis taraf mur raha hai.

Velocity
\[\mathbf{v}(t) = \mathbf{r}'(t) = 2\cos t\,\hat{i} + 3\,\hat{j}\]
\[\mathbf{v}\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right) = 2\cos\tfrac{\pi}{2}\,\hat{i} + 3\,\hat{j}\]
\[= 0\,\hat{i} + 3\,\hat{j}\]
Kyun: \(2\sin t\) ka derivative \(2\cos t\) aur \(3t\) ka derivative 3. Phir \(\cos\frac{\pi}{2} = 0\) rakhne se \(\hat{i}\) wala hissa zero ho gaya.
Dhyan dein: pehle general \(\mathbf{v}(t)\) banayein, phir value rakhein; ulta karne se sab zero aa jata hai.

Acceleration
\[\mathbf{a}(t) = \mathbf{v}'(t) = -2\sin t\,\hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j}\]
\[\mathbf{a}\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right) = -2\,\hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j}\]
Kyun: \(2\cos t\) ka derivative \(-2\sin t\) (cos ke derivative mein minus aata hai), aur constant 3 ka derivative zero. \(\sin\frac{\pi}{2} = 1\) rakha to \(-2\,\hat{i}\) bacha.

Speed
\[|\mathbf{v}(t)| = \sqrt{(2\cos t)^{2} + 3^{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{4\cos^{2}t + 9}\]
\[\left|\mathbf{v}\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\right| = \sqrt{0 + 9} = 3\]
Kyun: speed velocity vector ki lambai hai, jo Pythagoras ki tarah components ke squares ke jama ka square root hoti hai.

Direction of motion
\[\hat{\mathbf{v}}\left(\tfrac{\pi}{2}\right) = \dfrac{0\,\hat{i} + 3\,\hat{j}}{3}\]
\[= 0\,\hat{i} + \hat{j}\]
Kyun: velocity ko speed se divide karne se simt wahi rehti hai aur lambai 1 ho jati hai. Yahi unit tangent vector hai.

Tashreeh (interpretation)
Position: \(\mathbf{r}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = 2\,\hat{i} + \frac{3\pi}{2}\hat{j}\), yani point \((2, 4.71)\). Particle 3 units per second se seedha positive \(y\)-direction (upar) ja raha hai; is lamhe daayen baayen koi harkat nahin.
\[\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} = (0)(-2) + (3)(0) = 0\]
Is liye is lamhe speed na barh rahi hai na ghat rahi hai. Asal mein \(\sqrt{4\cos^{2}t + 9}\) kabhi 3 se kam nahin hota, to 3 sab se kam speed hai: particle abhi abhi dheema hona khatam kar chuka hai aur ab dobara tez hoga.
\(\mathbf{a} = -2\,\hat{i}\) velocity ke perpendicular hai aur baayen (negative \(x\)) ki taraf hai, is liye path baayen, yani \(y\)-axis ki taraf, mur raha hai. \(x = 2\sin t\) yahan apni sab se bari value 2 par hai: particle apne lehredar (wavy) raaste ke sab se daayen point par hai aur wapas mur raha hai, jaise jhoola apne aakhri kinare par.
Kyun: \(\frac{d}{dt}|\mathbf{v}|^{2} = 2\,\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a}\); aur jo acceleration velocity ke aar paar ho woh path ko apni taraf morta hai.

Khulasa
Ek nazar mein: is lamhe particle point \((2, 4.71)\) par hai, seedha upar 3 units per second se ja raha hai, us ki speed apni sab se kam value par hai, aur acceleration use baayen ki taraf mor raha hai. Exam mein sirf numbers likh dena kaafi nahin; sawal ne saaf kaha hai ke harkat ko lafzon mein bayan karo. Is liye har jawab ke saath yeh chaar baatein likhiye: kahan hai, kis taraf aur kitni tez ja raha hai, tez ho raha hai ya dheema, aur path kis taraf mur raha hai.

Tasdeeq
\[|\hat{\mathbf{v}}| = \sqrt{0^{2} + 1^{2}} = 1\]
Aur \(y\)-velocity hamesha 3 hai, yani particle barabar upar charhta hai jab ke \(x\) \(-2\) aur \(2\) ke darmiyan jhoolta hai. Figure mein bilkul yahi nazar aata hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(\mathbf{v}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = 0\,\hat{i} + 3\,\hat{j}\), \(\mathbf{a}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right) = -2\,\hat{i} + 0\,\hat{j}\), speed \(= 3\), direction \(\hat{\mathbf{v}} = \hat{j}\) (positive \(y\)-direction). Is lamhe speed nahin badal rahi (yeh sab se kam speed hai, \(\mathbf{v}\cdot\mathbf{a} = 0\)), aur path negative \(x\) ki taraf mur raha hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kitab mein Exercise 11.3 ke jawab chhape hue nahin hain (Unit 11 ki kisi exercise ke jawab kitab mein nahin hain). Is page ka har jawab hamara apna hai: qadam ba qadam hal kiya gaya, computer algebra system (sympy) se alag se check kiya gaya, aur ek solution book se bhi milaya gaya. \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) jaise angles radians mein hain, is liye calculator RAD mode mein rakhein. Apna hal yahan wale hal se mila kar dekhiye.
